module net.idna

# UTS #46 Unicode IDNA Compatibility Processing (revision 33, Unicode
# 16.0.0) and the Punycode codec of RFC 3492, in pure RCE over code
# points (List[i64]). Steps of section 4: map with the IdnaMappingTable,
# normalize to NFC (UAX #15, canonical decomposition, reordering and
# composition, Hangul algorithmic), break at U+002E, convert and validate
# each label (4.1: hyphens, leading mark, status, STD3 ASCII, ContextJ of
# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 and A.2, the six bidi rules of RFC 5893 section
# 2). ToASCII (4.2) adds Punycode with the "xn--" prefix and the DNS
# length checks; ToUnicode (4.3) returns code points, since rce 0.1.3
# cannot build text from arbitrary code points. Every operation returns
# its output together with an error flag, as UTS #46 specifies ("the
# conversion is performed as much as is possible"); the status codes are
# not reproduced (IdnaTestV2.txt requires only the error flag).
# The data section below is generated from the pinned Unicode files
# (vectors/SOURCE.md lists each file with its sha256).

pub struct Flags
    std3: bool
    hyphens: bool
    bidi: bool
    joiners: bool
    transitional: bool
    dns_length: bool
    ignore_bad_punycode: bool

pub struct Cps
    cps: List[i64]
    err: bool

pub struct Ascii
    host: text
    err: bool

# The flags of IdnaTestV2.txt (all checks on) and of the WHATWG URL
# Standard "domain to ASCII" with beStrict false.
pub fn test_flags(transitional: bool) -> Flags = Flags(std3: true, hyphens: true, bidi: true, joiners: true, transitional: transitional, dns_length: true, ignore_bad_punycode: false)
pub fn url_flags() -> Flags = Flags(std3: false, hyphens: false, bidi: true, joiners: true, transitional: false, dns_length: false, ignore_bad_punycode: false)

# ---------------- NFC (UAX #15) ----------------

const S_BASE: i64 = 44032
const L_BASE: i64 = 4352
const V_BASE: i64 = 4449
const T_BASE: i64 = 4519
const S_COUNT: i64 = 11172
const T_COUNT: i64 = 28
const N_COUNT: i64 = 588

fn decompose_into(o: &mut List[i64], c: i64)
    if c >= S_BASE and c < S_BASE + S_COUNT
        let s = c - S_BASE
        o.push(L_BASE + s / N_COUNT)
        o.push(V_BASE + (s % N_COUNT) / T_COUNT)
        if s % T_COUNT != 0
            o.push(T_BASE + s % T_COUNT)
        return
    let d = decomposition(c)
    if d.len() == 0
        o.push(c)
        return
    for x in d
        o.push(x)

# Canonical decomposition followed by the canonical ordering algorithm.
pub fn nfd(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in cps
        decompose_into(&mut o, c)
    var cc: List[i64] = []
    for c in o
        cc.push(ccc(c))
    # stable insertion sort of each run of non-starters by class
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < o.len() bound 16777216
        var j = i
        while j > 0 and cc[j] != 0 and cc[j - 1] > cc[j] bound 16777216
            let t = o[j]
            o[j] = o[j - 1]
            o[j - 1] = t
            let u = cc[j]
            cc[j] = cc[j - 1]
            cc[j - 1] = u
            j -= 1
        i += 1
    return o

fn compose_pair(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64
    if a >= L_BASE and a < L_BASE + 19 and b >= V_BASE and b < V_BASE + 21
        return S_BASE + ((a - L_BASE) * 21 + (b - V_BASE)) * T_COUNT
    if a >= S_BASE and a < S_BASE + S_COUNT and (a - S_BASE) % T_COUNT == 0 and b > T_BASE and b < T_BASE + T_COUNT
        return a + (b - T_BASE)
    return composite(a * 1114112 + b)

pub fn nfc(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let d = nfd(cps)
    var o: List[i64] = []
    if d.len() == 0
        return o
    var sp: usize = 0
    var last = ccc(d[0])
    var starter = last == 0
    o.push(d[0])
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < d.len() bound 16777216
        let c = d[i]
        let cl = ccc(c)
        let comp = if starter then compose_pair(o[sp], c) else -1
        if starter and (last < cl or last == 0) and comp >= 0
            o[sp] = comp
            i += 1
            continue
        if cl == 0
            sp = o.len()
            starter = true
        last = cl
        o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- Punycode (RFC 3492) ----------------

const P_BASE: i64 = 36
const P_TMIN: i64 = 1
const P_TMAX: i64 = 26
const P_MAX: i64 = 2147483647

fn adapt(delta0: i64, numpoints: i64, first: bool) -> i64
    var delta = if first then delta0 / 700 else delta0 / 2
    delta += delta / numpoints
    var k: i64 = 0
    while delta > ((P_BASE - P_TMIN) * P_TMAX) / 2 bound 64
        delta = delta / (P_BASE - P_TMIN)
        k += P_BASE
    return k + (P_BASE - P_TMIN + 1) * delta / (delta + 38)

fn digit_value(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 22
    if c >= 65 and c <= 90
        return c - 65
    if c >= 97 and c <= 122
        return c - 97
    return -1

fn digit_char(d: i64) -> i64 = if d < 26 then d + 97 else d + 22

fn thresh(k: i64, bias: i64) -> i64
    if k <= bias
        return P_TMIN
    if k >= bias + P_TMAX
        return P_TMAX
    return k - bias

# Decoding; a failure (bad digit, end inside a number, overflow, a
# result that is not a scalar value) gives err.
pub fn puny_decode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var b: usize = 0
    var j: usize = 0
    while j < input.len() bound 16777216
        if input[j] == 45
            b = j
        j += 1
    var k: usize = 0
    while k < b bound 16777216
        if input[k] >= 128
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(input[k])
        k += 1
    var p: usize = if b > 0 then b + 1 else 0
    var n: i64 = 128
    var i: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    while p < input.len() bound 16777216
        let oldi = i
        var w: i64 = 1
        var kk: i64 = P_BASE
        loop bound 64
            if p >= input.len()
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            let d = digit_value(input[p])
            p += 1
            if d < 0
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if d > (P_MAX - i) / w
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)

            let t = thresh(kk, bias)
            if d < t
                break
            if w > P_MAX / (P_BASE - t)
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            w = w * (P_BASE - t)
            kk += P_BASE

        bias = adapt(i - oldi, len, oldi == 0)
        if i / len > P_MAX - n
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        n += i / len
        i = i % len
        if n > 1114111 or (n >= 55296 and n <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(n)
        var q = o.len() - 1
        while q > i as usize bound 16777216
            o[q] = o[q - 1]
            q -= 1

        i += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

pub fn puny_encode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        if c < 0 or c > 1114111 or (c >= 55296 and c <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        if c < 128
            o.push(c)
    let basic = o.len() as i64
    var h = basic
    if basic > 0
        o.push(45)
    var n: i64 = 128
    var delta: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    let total = input.len() as i64
    while h < total bound 16777216
        var m: i64 = P_MAX
        for c in input
            if c >= n and c < m
                m = c
        if m - n > (P_MAX - delta) / (h + 1)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        delta += (m - n) * (h + 1)
        n = m
        for c in input
            if c < n
                delta += 1
                if delta > P_MAX
                    return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if c == n
                var q = delta
                var k: i64 = P_BASE
                loop bound 64
                    let t = thresh(k, bias)
                    if q < t
                        break
                    o.push(digit_char(t + (q - t) % (P_BASE - t)))
                    q = (q - t) / (P_BASE - t)
                    k += P_BASE

                h += 1

# ---------------- UTS #46 processing ----------------

fn is_xn(l: &[i64]) -> bool = l.len() >= 4 and (l[0] == 120 or l[0] == 88) and (l[1] == 110 or l[1] == 78) and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45

fn all_ascii(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        if c >= 128
            return false
    return true

fn is_rtl_label(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 1 or b == 2 or b == 3
            return true
    return false

# RFC 5893 section 2, rules 1 to 6, for one label of a bidi domain.
pub fn bidi_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    let f = bidi_class(l[0])
    if f != 0 and f != 1 and f != 2
        return false
    var e = l.len()
    while e > 0 and bidi_class(l[e - 1]) == 10 bound 16777216
        e -= 1
    if e == 0
        return false
    let last = bidi_class(l[e - 1])
    if f == 0
        for c in l
            let b = bidi_class(c)
            if b != 0 and b != 4 and b != 5 and b != 6 and b != 7 and b != 8 and b != 9 and b != 10
                return false
        return last == 0 or last == 4
    var en = false
    var an = false
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 0 or b > 10
            return false
        if b == 4
            en = true
        if b == 3
            an = true
    if en and an
        return false
    return last == 1 or last == 2 or last == 4 or last == 3

# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 (ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER) and A.2 (ZERO WIDTH JOINER).
pub fn joiners_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < l.len() bound 16777216
        let c = l[i]
        if c == 8204 or c == 8205
            let virama = i > 0 and ccc(l[i - 1]) == 9
            if not virama
                if c == 8205
                    return false
                var a = i
                var left = false
                while a > 0 bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[a - 1])
                    if t == 5
                        a -= 1
                        continue
                    left = t == 2 or t == 4
                    break
                var z = i + 1
                var right = false
                while z < l.len() bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[z])
                    if t == 5
                        z += 1
                        continue
                    right = t == 2 or t == 3
                    break
                if not (left and right)
                    return false
        i += 1
    return true

# Validity criteria 4.1 except the bidi rules (checked per domain).
fn valid_label(l: &[i64], f: &Flags, transitional: bool, decoded: bool) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    if decoded
        let n = nfc(l)
        if n != copy(l)
            return false
    if f.hyphens
        if l.len() >= 4 and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45
            return false
        if l[0] == 45 or l[l.len() - 1] == 45
            return false
    elif is_xn(l)
        return false
    if is_mark(l[0])
        return false
    for c in l
        if c == 46
            return false
        let s = status(c)
        if not (s == 0 or (s == 2 and not transitional))
            return false
        if f.std3 and c < 128 and not ((c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) or c == 45)
            return false
    if f.joiners and not joiners_ok(l)
        return false
    return true

pub struct Labels
    labels: List[List[i64]]
    err: bool

# Section 4 processing: the converted labels and the error flag.
pub fn process(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Labels
    var m: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        let s = status(c)
        if s == 4
            continue
        if s == 1
            if f.transitional and c == 7838
                m.push(115)
                m.push(115)
            else
                for x in mapping(c)
                    m.push(x)
        elif s == 2 and f.transitional
            for x in mapping(c)
                m.push(x)
        else
            m.push(c)
    let n = nfc(&m)
    var raw: List[List[i64]] = []
    var cur: List[i64] = []
    for c in n
        if c == 46
            raw.push(cur)
            cur = []
        else
            cur.push(c)
    raw.push(cur)
    var err = false
    var out: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in raw
        if is_xn(&l)
            if not all_ascii(&l)
                err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var rest: List[i64] = []
            var k: usize = 4
            while k < l.len() bound 16777216
                rest.push(l[k])
                k += 1
            let d = puny_decode(&rest)
            if d.err
                if not f.ignore_bad_punycode
                    err = true
                    out.push(copy(l))
                    continue
                if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                    err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            if d.cps.len() == 0 or all_ascii(&d.cps)
                err = true
            if not valid_label(&d.cps, f, false, true)
                err = true
            out.push(d.cps)
        else
            if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                err = true
            out.push(copy(l))
    if f.bidi
        var rtl = false
        for l in out
            if is_rtl_label(&l)
                rtl = true
        if rtl
            for l in out
                if not bidi_ok(&l)
                    err = true
    return Labels(labels: out, err: err)

fn join_dots(ls: &[List[i64]]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < ls.len() bound 16777216
        if i > 0
            o.push(46)
        for c in ls[i]
            o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# 4.3 ToUnicode.
pub fn to_unicode(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    return Cps(cps: join_dots(&p.labels), err: p.err)

const ASCII_TAB: text = "\u{0}\u{1}\u{2}\u{3}\u{4}\u{5}\u{6}\u{7}\u{8}\t\n\u{b}\u{c}\r\u{e}\u{f}\u{10}\u{11}\u{12}\u{13}\u{14}\u{15}\u{16}\u{17}\u{18}\u{19}\u{1a}\u{1b}\u{1c}\u{1d}\u{1e}\u{1f} !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~\u{7f}"

# ASCII code points as text; any other code point is written U+FFFD
# (only reachable in an output that also carries err).
pub fn ascii_text(cps: &[i64]) -> text
    let t = ASCII_TAB.chars()
    var o = ""
    for c in cps
        o = o + (if c >= 0 and c < 128 then copy(t[c as usize]) else "\u{fffd}")
    return o

# 4.2 ToASCII.
pub fn to_ascii_cps(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    var err = p.err
    var ls: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in p.labels
        if all_ascii(&l)
            ls.push(copy(l))
        else
            let e = puny_encode(&l)
            if e.err
                err = true
                ls.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var x: List[i64] = [120, 110, 45, 45]
            for c in e.cps
                x.push(c)
            ls.push(x)
    let o = join_dots(&ls)
    if f.dns_length
        if o.len() < 1 or o.len() > 253
            err = true
        for l in ls
            if l.len() < 1 or l.len() > 63
                err = true
    return Cps(cps: o, err: err)

pub fn to_ascii(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Ascii
    let r = to_ascii_cps(input, f)
    return Ascii(host: ascii_text(&r.cps), err: r.err)

# Code points of UTF-8 text (text is always well formed).
pub fn text_cps(t: &text) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < t.len_bytes() bound 67108864
        let b = t[i] as i64
        if b < 128
            o.push(b)
            i += 1
        elif b < 224
            o.push((b & 31) << 6 | (t[i + 1] as i64 & 63))
            i += 2
        elif b < 240
            o.push((b & 15) << 12 | (t[i + 1] as i64 & 63) << 6 | (t[i + 2] as i64 & 63))
            i += 3
        else
            o.push((b & 7) << 18 | (t[i + 1] as i64 & 63) << 12 | (t[i + 2] as i64 & 63) << 6 | (t[i + 3] as i64 & 63))
            i += 4
    return o

# Canonical decomposition followed by the canonical ordering algorithm.
pub fn nfd(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in cps
        decompose_into(&mut o, c)
    var cc: List[i64] = []
    for c in o
        cc.push(ccc(c))
    # stable insertion sort of each run of non-starters by class
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < o.len() bound 16777216
        var j = i
        while j > 0 and cc[j] != 0 and cc[j - 1] > cc[j] bound 16777216
            let t = o[j]
            o[j] = o[j - 1]
            o[j - 1] = t
            let u = cc[j]
            cc[j] = cc[j - 1]
            cc[j - 1] = u
            j -= 1
        i += 1
    return o

fn compose_pair(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64
    if a >= L_BASE and a < L_BASE + 19 and b >= V_BASE and b < V_BASE + 21
        return S_BASE + ((a - L_BASE) * 21 + (b - V_BASE)) * T_COUNT
    if a >= S_BASE and a < S_BASE + S_COUNT and (a - S_BASE) % T_COUNT == 0 and b > T_BASE and b < T_BASE + T_COUNT
        return a + (b - T_BASE)
    return composite(a * 1114112 + b)

pub fn nfc(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let d = nfd(cps)
    var o: List[i64] = []
    if d.len() == 0
        return o
    var sp: usize = 0
    var last = ccc(d[0])
    var starter = last == 0
    o.push(d[0])
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < d.len() bound 16777216
        let c = d[i]
        let cl = ccc(c)
        let comp = if starter then compose_pair(o[sp], c) else -1
        if starter and (last < cl or last == 0) and comp >= 0
            o[sp] = comp
            i += 1
            continue
        if cl == 0
            sp = o.len()
            starter = true
        last = cl
        o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- Punycode (RFC 3492) ----------------

const P_BASE: i64 = 36
const P_TMIN: i64 = 1
const P_TMAX: i64 = 26
const P_MAX: i64 = 2147483647

fn adapt(delta0: i64, numpoints: i64, first: bool) -> i64
    var delta = if first then delta0 / 700 else delta0 / 2
    delta += delta / numpoints
    var k: i64 = 0
    while delta > ((P_BASE - P_TMIN) * P_TMAX) / 2 bound 64
        delta = delta / (P_BASE - P_TMIN)
        k += P_BASE
    return k + (P_BASE - P_TMIN + 1) * delta / (delta + 38)

fn digit_value(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 22
    if c >= 65 and c <= 90
        return c - 65
    if c >= 97 and c <= 122
        return c - 97
    return -1

fn digit_char(d: i64) -> i64 = if d < 26 then d + 97 else d + 22

fn thresh(k: i64, bias: i64) -> i64
    if k <= bias
        return P_TMIN
    if k >= bias + P_TMAX
        return P_TMAX
    return k - bias

# Decoding; a failure (bad digit, end inside a number, overflow, a
# result that is not a scalar value) gives err.
pub fn puny_decode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var b: usize = 0
    var j: usize = 0
    while j < input.len() bound 16777216
        if input[j] == 45
            b = j
        j += 1
    var k: usize = 0
    while k < b bound 16777216
        if input[k] >= 128
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(input[k])
        k += 1
    var p: usize = if b > 0 then b + 1 else 0
    var n: i64 = 128
    var i: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    while p < input.len() bound 16777216
        let oldi = i
        var w: i64 = 1
        var kk: i64 = P_BASE
        loop bound 64
            if p >= input.len()
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            let d = digit_value(input[p])
            p += 1
            if d < 0
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if d > (P_MAX - i) / w
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            i += d * w
            let t = thresh(kk, bias)
            if d < t
                break
            if w > P_MAX / (P_BASE - t)
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            w = w * (P_BASE - t)
            kk += P_BASE
        let len = o.len() as i64 + 1
        bias = adapt(i - oldi, len, oldi == 0)
        if i / len > P_MAX - n
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        n += i / len
        i = i % len
        if n > 1114111 or (n >= 55296 and n <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(n)
        var q = o.len() - 1
        while q > i as usize bound 16777216
            o[q] = o[q - 1]
            q -= 1
        o[i as usize] = n
        i += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

pub fn puny_encode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        if c < 0 or c > 1114111 or (c >= 55296 and c <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        if c < 128
            o.push(c)
    let basic = o.len() as i64
    var h = basic
    if basic > 0
        o.push(45)
    var n: i64 = 128
    var delta: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    let total = input.len() as i64
    while h < total bound 16777216
        var m: i64 = P_MAX
        for c in input
            if c >= n and c < m
                m = c
        if m - n > (P_MAX - delta) / (h + 1)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        delta += (m - n) * (h + 1)
        n = m
        for c in input
            if c < n
                delta += 1
                if delta > P_MAX
                    return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if c == n
                var q = delta
                var k: i64 = P_BASE
                loop bound 64
                    let t = thresh(k, bias)
                    if q < t
                        break
                    o.push(digit_char(t + (q - t) % (P_BASE - t)))
                    q = (q - t) / (P_BASE - t)
                    k += P_BASE
                o.push(digit_char(q))
                bias = adapt(delta, h + 1, h == basic)
                delta = 0
                h += 1
        delta += 1
        n += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

# ---------------- UTS #46 processing ----------------

fn is_xn(l: &[i64]) -> bool = l.len() >= 4 and (l[0] == 120 or l[0] == 88) and (l[1] == 110 or l[1] == 78) and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45

fn all_ascii(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        if c >= 128
            return false
    return true

fn is_rtl_label(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 1 or b == 2 or b == 3
            return true
    return false

# RFC 5893 section 2, rules 1 to 6, for one label of a bidi domain.
pub fn bidi_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    let f = bidi_class(l[0])
    if f != 0 and f != 1 and f != 2
        return false
    var e = l.len()
    while e > 0 and bidi_class(l[e - 1]) == 10 bound 16777216
        e -= 1
    if e == 0
        return false
    let last = bidi_class(l[e - 1])
    if f == 0
        for c in l
            let b = bidi_class(c)
            if b != 0 and b != 4 and b != 5 and b != 6 and b != 7 and b != 8 and b != 9 and b != 10
                return false
        return last == 0 or last == 4
    var en = false
    var an = false
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 0 or b > 10
            return false
        if b == 4
            en = true
        if b == 3
            an = true
    if en and an
        return false
    return last == 1 or last == 2 or last == 4 or last == 3

# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 (ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER) and A.2 (ZERO WIDTH JOINER).
pub fn joiners_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < l.len() bound 16777216
        let c = l[i]
        if c == 8204 or c == 8205
            let virama = i > 0 and ccc(l[i - 1]) == 9
            if not virama
                if c == 8205
                    return false
                var a = i
                var left = false
                while a > 0 bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[a - 1])
                    if t == 5
                        a -= 1
                        continue
                    left = t == 2 or t == 4
                    break
                var z = i + 1
                var right = false
                while z < l.len() bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[z])
                    if t == 5
                        z += 1
                        continue
                    right = t == 2 or t == 3
                    break
                if not (left and right)
                    return false
        i += 1
    return true

# Validity criteria 4.1 except the bidi rules (checked per domain).
fn valid_label(l: &[i64], f: &Flags, transitional: bool, decoded: bool) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    if decoded
        let n = nfc(l)
        if n != copy(l)
            return false
    if f.hyphens
        if l.len() >= 4 and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45
            return false
        if l[0] == 45 or l[l.len() - 1] == 45
            return false
    elif is_xn(l)
        return false
    if is_mark(l[0])
        return false
    for c in l
        if c == 46
            return false
        let s = status(c)
        if not (s == 0 or (s == 2 and not transitional))
            return false
        if f.std3 and c < 128 and not ((c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) or c == 45)
            return false
    if f.joiners and not joiners_ok(l)
        return false
    return true

pub struct Labels
    labels: List[List[i64]]
    err: bool

# Section 4 processing: the converted labels and the error flag.
pub fn process(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Labels
    var m: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        let s = status(c)
        if s == 4
            continue
        if s == 1
            if f.transitional and c == 7838
                m.push(115)
                m.push(115)
            else
                for x in mapping(c)
                    m.push(x)
        elif s == 2 and f.transitional
            for x in mapping(c)
                m.push(x)
        else
            m.push(c)
    let n = nfc(&m)
    var raw: List[List[i64]] = []
    var cur: List[i64] = []
    for c in n
        if c == 46
            raw.push(cur)
            cur = []
        else
            cur.push(c)
    raw.push(cur)
    var err = false
    var out: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in raw
        if is_xn(&l)
            if not all_ascii(&l)
                err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var rest: List[i64] = []
            var k: usize = 4
            while k < l.len() bound 16777216
                rest.push(l[k])
                k += 1
            let d = puny_decode(&rest)
            if d.err
                if not f.ignore_bad_punycode
                    err = true
                    out.push(copy(l))
                    continue
                if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                    err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            if d.cps.len() == 0 or all_ascii(&d.cps)
                err = true
            if not valid_label(&d.cps, f, false, true)
                err = true
            out.push(d.cps)
        else
            if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                err = true
            out.push(copy(l))
    if f.bidi
        var rtl = false
        for l in out
            if is_rtl_label(&l)
                rtl = true
        if rtl
            for l in out
                if not bidi_ok(&l)
                    err = true
    return Labels(labels: out, err: err)

fn join_dots(ls: &[List[i64]]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < ls.len() bound 16777216
        if i > 0
            o.push(46)
        for c in ls[i]
            o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

pub fn to_unicode(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    return Cps(cps: join_dots(&p.labels), err: p.err)

pub fn ascii_text(cps: &[i64]) -> text
    let t = ASCII_TAB.chars()
    var o = ""
    for c in cps

pub fn to_ascii_cps(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    var err = p.err
    var ls: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in p.labels
        if all_ascii(&l)
            ls.push(copy(l))
        else
            let e = puny_encode(&l)
            if e.err
                err = true
                ls.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var x: List[i64] = [120, 110, 45, 45]
            for c in e.cps
                x.push(c)
            ls.push(x)
    let o = join_dots(&ls)
    if f.dns_length
        if o.len() < 1 or o.len() > 253
            err = true
        for l in ls
            if l.len() < 1 or l.len() > 63
                err = true
    return Cps(cps: o, err: err)

module net.idna

# UTS #46 Unicode IDNA Compatibility Processing (revision 33, Unicode
# 16.0.0) and the Punycode codec of RFC 3492, in pure RCE over code
# points (List[i64]). Steps of section 4: map with the IdnaMappingTable,
# normalize to NFC (UAX #15, canonical decomposition, reordering and
# composition, Hangul algorithmic), break at U+002E, convert and validate
# each label (4.1: hyphens, leading mark, status, STD3 ASCII, ContextJ of
# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 and A.2, the six bidi rules of RFC 5893 section
# 2). ToASCII (4.2) adds Punycode with the "xn--" prefix and the DNS
# length checks; ToUnicode (4.3) returns code points, since rce 0.1.3
# cannot build text from arbitrary code points. Every operation returns
# its output together with an error flag, as UTS #46 specifies ("the
# conversion is performed as much as is possible"); the status codes are
# not reproduced (IdnaTestV2.txt requires only the error flag).
# The data section below is generated from the pinned Unicode files
# (vectors/SOURCE.md lists each file with its sha256).

pub struct Flags
    std3: bool
    hyphens: bool
    bidi: bool
    joiners: bool
    transitional: bool
    dns_length: bool
    ignore_bad_punycode: bool

    cps: List[i64]

# ---------------- NFC (UAX #15) ----------------

const S_BASE: i64 = 44032
const L_BASE: i64 = 4352
const V_BASE: i64 = 4449
const T_BASE: i64 = 4519
const S_COUNT: i64 = 11172
const T_COUNT: i64 = 28
const N_COUNT: i64 = 588

fn decompose_into(o: &mut List[i64], c: i64)
    if c >= S_BASE and c < S_BASE + S_COUNT
        let s = c - S_BASE
        o.push(L_BASE + s / N_COUNT)
        o.push(V_BASE + (s % N_COUNT) / T_COUNT)
        if s % T_COUNT != 0
            o.push(T_BASE + s % T_COUNT)
        return
    let d = decomposition(c)
    if d.len() == 0
        o.push(c)
        return
    for x in d
        o.push(x)

# Canonical decomposition followed by the canonical ordering algorithm.
pub fn nfd(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in cps
        decompose_into(&mut o, c)
    var cc: List[i64] = []
    for c in o
        cc.push(ccc(c))
    # stable insertion sort of each run of non-starters by class
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < o.len() bound 16777216
        var j = i
        while j > 0 and cc[j] != 0 and cc[j - 1] > cc[j] bound 16777216
            let t = o[j]
            o[j] = o[j - 1]
            o[j - 1] = t
            let u = cc[j]
            cc[j] = cc[j - 1]
            cc[j - 1] = u
            j -= 1
        i += 1
    return o

fn compose_pair(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64
    if a >= L_BASE and a < L_BASE + 19 and b >= V_BASE and b < V_BASE + 21
        return S_BASE + ((a - L_BASE) * 21 + (b - V_BASE)) * T_COUNT
    if a >= S_BASE and a < S_BASE + S_COUNT and (a - S_BASE) % T_COUNT == 0 and b > T_BASE and b < T_BASE + T_COUNT
        return a + (b - T_BASE)
    return composite(a * 1114112 + b)

pub fn nfc(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let d = nfd(cps)
    var o: List[i64] = []
    if d.len() == 0
        return o
    var sp: usize = 0
    var last = ccc(d[0])
    var starter = last == 0
    o.push(d[0])
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < d.len() bound 16777216
        let c = d[i]
        let cl = ccc(c)
        let comp = if starter then compose_pair(o[sp], c) else -1
        if starter and (last < cl or last == 0) and comp >= 0
            o[sp] = comp
            i += 1
            continue
        if cl == 0
            sp = o.len()
            starter = true
        last = cl
        o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- Punycode (RFC 3492) ----------------

const P_BASE: i64 = 36
const P_TMIN: i64 = 1
const P_TMAX: i64 = 26
const P_MAX: i64 = 2147483647

fn adapt(delta0: i64, numpoints: i64, first: bool) -> i64
    var delta = if first then delta0 / 700 else delta0 / 2
    delta += delta / numpoints
    var k: i64 = 0
    while delta > ((P_BASE - P_TMIN) * P_TMAX) / 2 bound 64
        delta = delta / (P_BASE - P_TMIN)
        k += P_BASE
    return k + (P_BASE - P_TMIN + 1) * delta / (delta + 38)

fn digit_value(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 22
    if c >= 65 and c <= 90
        return c - 65
    if c >= 97 and c <= 122
        return c - 97
    return -1

fn digit_char(d: i64) -> i64 = if d < 26 then d + 97 else d + 22

fn thresh(k: i64, bias: i64) -> i64
    if k <= bias
        return P_TMIN
    if k >= bias + P_TMAX
        return P_TMAX
    return k - bias

# Decoding; a failure (bad digit, end inside a number, overflow, a
# result that is not a scalar value) gives err.
pub fn puny_decode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var b: usize = 0
    var j: usize = 0
    while j < input.len() bound 16777216
        if input[j] == 45
            b = j
        j += 1
    var k: usize = 0
    while k < b bound 16777216
        if input[k] >= 128
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(input[k])
        k += 1
    var p: usize = if b > 0 then b + 1 else 0
    var n: i64 = 128
    var i: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    while p < input.len() bound 16777216
        let oldi = i
        var w: i64 = 1
        var kk: i64 = P_BASE
        loop bound 64
            if p >= input.len()
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            let d = digit_value(input[p])
            p += 1
            if d < 0
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if d > (P_MAX - i) / w
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            i += d * w
            let t = thresh(kk, bias)
            if d < t
                break
            if w > P_MAX / (P_BASE - t)
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            w = w * (P_BASE - t)
            kk += P_BASE
        let len = o.len() as i64 + 1
        bias = adapt(i - oldi, len, oldi == 0)
        if i / len > P_MAX - n
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        n += i / len
        i = i % len
        if n > 1114111 or (n >= 55296 and n <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(n)
        var q = o.len() - 1
        while q > i as usize bound 16777216
            o[q] = o[q - 1]
            q -= 1
        o[i as usize] = n
        i += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

pub fn puny_encode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        if c < 0 or c > 1114111 or (c >= 55296 and c <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        if c < 128
            o.push(c)
    let basic = o.len() as i64
    var h = basic
    if basic > 0
        o.push(45)
    var n: i64 = 128
    var delta: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    let total = input.len() as i64
    while h < total bound 16777216
        var m: i64 = P_MAX
        for c in input
            if c >= n and c < m
                m = c
        if m - n > (P_MAX - delta) / (h + 1)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        delta += (m - n) * (h + 1)
        n = m
        for c in input
            if c < n
                delta += 1
                if delta > P_MAX
                    return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if c == n
                var q = delta
                var k: i64 = P_BASE
                loop bound 64
                    let t = thresh(k, bias)
                    if q < t
                        break
                    o.push(digit_char(t + (q - t) % (P_BASE - t)))
                    q = (q - t) / (P_BASE - t)
                    k += P_BASE
                o.push(digit_char(q))
                bias = adapt(delta, h + 1, h == basic)
                delta = 0
                h += 1
        delta += 1
        n += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

# ---------------- UTS #46 processing ----------------

fn is_xn(l: &[i64]) -> bool = l.len() >= 4 and (l[0] == 120 or l[0] == 88) and (l[1] == 110 or l[1] == 78) and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45

fn all_ascii(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        if c >= 128
            return false
    return true

fn is_rtl_label(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 1 or b == 2 or b == 3
            return true
    return false

# RFC 5893 section 2, rules 1 to 6, for one label of a bidi domain.
pub fn bidi_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    let f = bidi_class(l[0])
    if f != 0 and f != 1 and f != 2
        return false
    var e = l.len()
    while e > 0 and bidi_class(l[e - 1]) == 10 bound 16777216
        e -= 1
    if e == 0
        return false
    let last = bidi_class(l[e - 1])
    if f == 0
        for c in l
            let b = bidi_class(c)
            if b != 0 and b != 4 and b != 5 and b != 6 and b != 7 and b != 8 and b != 9 and b != 10
                return false
        return last == 0 or last == 4
    var en = false
    var an = false
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 0 or b > 10
            return false
        if b == 4
            en = true
        if b == 3
            an = true
    if en and an
        return false
    return last == 1 or last == 2 or last == 4 or last == 3

# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 (ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER) and A.2 (ZERO WIDTH JOINER).
pub fn joiners_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < l.len() bound 16777216
        let c = l[i]
        if c == 8204 or c == 8205
            let virama = i > 0 and ccc(l[i - 1]) == 9
            if not virama
                if c == 8205
                    return false
                var a = i
                var left = false
                while a > 0 bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[a - 1])
                    if t == 5
                        a -= 1
                        continue
                    left = t == 2 or t == 4
                    break
                var z = i + 1
                var right = false
                while z < l.len() bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[z])
                    if t == 5
                        z += 1
                        continue
                    right = t == 2 or t == 3
                    break
                if not (left and right)
                    return false
        i += 1
    return true

# Validity criteria 4.1 except the bidi rules (checked per domain).
fn valid_label(l: &[i64], f: &Flags, transitional: bool, decoded: bool) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    if decoded
        let n = nfc(l)
        if n != copy(l)
            return false
    if f.hyphens
        if l.len() >= 4 and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45
            return false
        if l[0] == 45 or l[l.len() - 1] == 45
            return false
    elif is_xn(l)
        return false
    if is_mark(l[0])
        return false
    for c in l
        if c == 46
            return false
        let s = status(c)
        if not (s == 0 or (s == 2 and not transitional))
            return false
        if f.std3 and c < 128 and not ((c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) or c == 45)
            return false
    if f.joiners and not joiners_ok(l)
        return false
    return true

pub struct Labels
    labels: List[List[i64]]
    err: bool

# Section 4 processing: the converted labels and the error flag.
pub fn process(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Labels
    var m: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        let s = status(c)
        if s == 4
            continue
        if s == 1
            if f.transitional and c == 7838
                m.push(115)
                m.push(115)
            else
                for x in mapping(c)
                    m.push(x)
        elif s == 2 and f.transitional
            for x in mapping(c)
                m.push(x)
        else
            m.push(c)
    let n = nfc(&m)
    var raw: List[List[i64]] = []
    var cur: List[i64] = []
    for c in n
        if c == 46
            raw.push(cur)
            cur = []
        else
            cur.push(c)
    raw.push(cur)
    var err = false
    var out: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in raw
        if is_xn(&l)
            if not all_ascii(&l)
                err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var rest: List[i64] = []
            var k: usize = 4
            while k < l.len() bound 16777216
                rest.push(l[k])
                k += 1
            let d = puny_decode(&rest)
            if d.err
                if not f.ignore_bad_punycode
                    err = true
                    out.push(copy(l))
                    continue
                if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                    err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            if d.cps.len() == 0 or all_ascii(&d.cps)
                err = true
            if not valid_label(&d.cps, f, false, true)
                err = true
            out.push(d.cps)
        else
            if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                err = true
            out.push(copy(l))
    if f.bidi
        var rtl = false
        for l in out
            if is_rtl_label(&l)
                rtl = true
        if rtl
            for l in out
                if not bidi_ok(&l)
                    err = true
    return Labels(labels: out, err: err)

fn join_dots(ls: &[List[i64]]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < ls.len() bound 16777216
        if i > 0
            o.push(46)
        for c in ls[i]
            o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# 4.3 ToUnicode.
pub fn to_unicode(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    return Cps(cps: join_dots(&p.labels), err: p.err)

pub fn to_ascii_cps(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    var err = p.err
    var ls: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in p.labels
        if all_ascii(&l)
            ls.push(copy(l))
        else
            let e = puny_encode(&l)
            if e.err

    return Cps(cps: o, err: err)

module net.idna

# UTS #46 Unicode IDNA Compatibility Processing (revision 33, Unicode
# 16.0.0) and the Punycode codec of RFC 3492, in pure RCE over code
# points (List[i64]). Steps of section 4: map with the IdnaMappingTable,
# normalize to NFC (UAX #15, canonical decomposition, reordering and
# composition, Hangul algorithmic), break at U+002E, convert and validate
# each label (4.1: hyphens, leading mark, status, STD3 ASCII, ContextJ of
# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 and A.2, the six bidi rules of RFC 5893 section
# 2). ToASCII (4.2) adds Punycode with the "xn--" prefix and the DNS
# length checks; ToUnicode (4.3) returns code points, since rce 0.1.3
# cannot build text from arbitrary code points. Every operation returns
# its output together with an error flag, as UTS #46 specifies ("the
# conversion is performed as much as is possible"); the status codes are
# not reproduced (IdnaTestV2.txt requires only the error flag).
# The data section below is generated from the pinned Unicode files
# (vectors/SOURCE.md lists each file with its sha256).

pub struct Flags
    std3: bool
    hyphens: bool
    bidi: bool
    joiners: bool
    transitional: bool
    dns_length: bool
    ignore_bad_punycode: bool

pub struct Cps
    cps: List[i64]
    err: bool

pub struct Ascii
    host: text
    err: bool

# The flags of IdnaTestV2.txt (all checks on) and of the WHATWG URL
# Standard "domain to ASCII" with beStrict false.
pub fn test_flags(transitional: bool) -> Flags = Flags(std3: true, hyphens: true, bidi: true, joiners: true, transitional: transitional, dns_length: true, ignore_bad_punycode: false)
pub fn url_flags() -> Flags = Flags(std3: false, hyphens: false, bidi: true, joiners: true, transitional: false, dns_length: false, ignore_bad_punycode: false)

# ---------------- NFC (UAX #15) ----------------

const S_BASE: i64 = 44032
const L_BASE: i64 = 4352
const V_BASE: i64 = 4449
const T_BASE: i64 = 4519
const S_COUNT: i64 = 11172
const T_COUNT: i64 = 28
const N_COUNT: i64 = 588

fn decompose_into(o: &mut List[i64], c: i64)
    if c >= S_BASE and c < S_BASE + S_COUNT
        let s = c - S_BASE
        o.push(L_BASE + s / N_COUNT)
        o.push(V_BASE + (s % N_COUNT) / T_COUNT)
        if s % T_COUNT != 0
            o.push(T_BASE + s % T_COUNT)
        return
    let d = decomposition(c)
    if d.len() == 0
        o.push(c)
        return
    for x in d
        o.push(x)

# Canonical decomposition followed by the canonical ordering algorithm.
pub fn nfd(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in cps
        decompose_into(&mut o, c)
    var cc: List[i64] = []
    for c in o
        cc.push(ccc(c))
    # stable insertion sort of each run of non-starters by class
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < o.len() bound 16777216
        var j = i
        while j > 0 and cc[j] != 0 and cc[j - 1] > cc[j] bound 16777216
            let t = o[j]
            o[j] = o[j - 1]
            o[j - 1] = t
            let u = cc[j]
            cc[j] = cc[j - 1]
            cc[j - 1] = u
            j -= 1
        i += 1
    return o

fn compose_pair(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64
    if a >= L_BASE and a < L_BASE + 19 and b >= V_BASE and b < V_BASE + 21
        return S_BASE + ((a - L_BASE) * 21 + (b - V_BASE)) * T_COUNT
    if a >= S_BASE and a < S_BASE + S_COUNT and (a - S_BASE) % T_COUNT == 0 and b > T_BASE and b < T_BASE + T_COUNT
        return a + (b - T_BASE)
    return composite(a * 1114112 + b)

pub fn nfc(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let d = nfd(cps)
    var o: List[i64] = []
    if d.len() == 0
        return o
    var sp: usize = 0
    var last = ccc(d[0])
    var starter = last == 0
    o.push(d[0])
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < d.len() bound 16777216
        let c = d[i]
        let cl = ccc(c)
        let comp = if starter then compose_pair(o[sp], c) else -1
        if starter and (last < cl or last == 0) and comp >= 0
            o[sp] = comp
            i += 1
            continue
        if cl == 0
            sp = o.len()
            starter = true
        last = cl
        o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- Punycode (RFC 3492) ----------------

const P_BASE: i64 = 36
const P_TMIN: i64 = 1
const P_TMAX: i64 = 26
const P_MAX: i64 = 2147483647

fn adapt(delta0: i64, numpoints: i64, first: bool) -> i64
    var delta = if first then delta0 / 700 else delta0 / 2
    delta += delta / numpoints
    var k: i64 = 0
    while delta > ((P_BASE - P_TMIN) * P_TMAX) / 2 bound 64
        delta = delta / (P_BASE - P_TMIN)
        k += P_BASE
    return k + (P_BASE - P_TMIN + 1) * delta / (delta + 38)

fn digit_value(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 22
    if c >= 65 and c <= 90
        return c - 65
    if c >= 97 and c <= 122
        return c - 97
    return -1

fn digit_char(d: i64) -> i64 = if d < 26 then d + 97 else d + 22

fn thresh(k: i64, bias: i64) -> i64
    if k <= bias
        return P_TMIN
    if k >= bias + P_TMAX
        return P_TMAX
    return k - bias

# Decoding; a failure (bad digit, end inside a number, overflow, a
# result that is not a scalar value) gives err.
pub fn puny_decode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var b: usize = 0
    var j: usize = 0
    while j < input.len() bound 16777216
        if input[j] == 45
            b = j
        j += 1
    var k: usize = 0
    while k < b bound 16777216
        if input[k] >= 128
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(input[k])
        k += 1
    var p: usize = if b > 0 then b + 1 else 0
    var n: i64 = 128
    var i: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    while p < input.len() bound 16777216
        let oldi = i
        var w: i64 = 1
        var kk: i64 = P_BASE
        loop bound 64
            if p >= input.len()
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            let d = digit_value(input[p])
            p += 1
            if d < 0
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if d > (P_MAX - i) / w
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            i += d * w
            let t = thresh(kk, bias)
            if d < t
                break
            if w > P_MAX / (P_BASE - t)
                return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            w = w * (P_BASE - t)
            kk += P_BASE
        let len = o.len() as i64 + 1
        bias = adapt(i - oldi, len, oldi == 0)
        if i / len > P_MAX - n
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        n += i / len
        i = i % len
        if n > 1114111 or (n >= 55296 and n <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        o.push(n)
        var q = o.len() - 1
        while q > i as usize bound 16777216
            o[q] = o[q - 1]
            q -= 1
        o[i as usize] = n
        i += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

pub fn puny_encode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        if c < 0 or c > 1114111 or (c >= 55296 and c <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        if c < 128
            o.push(c)
    let basic = o.len() as i64
    var h = basic
    if basic > 0
        o.push(45)
    var n: i64 = 128
    var delta: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    let total = input.len() as i64
    while h < total bound 16777216
        var m: i64 = P_MAX
        for c in input
            if c >= n and c < m
                m = c
        if m - n > (P_MAX - delta) / (h + 1)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        delta += (m - n) * (h + 1)
        n = m
        for c in input
            if c < n
                delta += 1
                if delta > P_MAX
                    return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if c == n
                var q = delta
                var k: i64 = P_BASE
                loop bound 64
                    let t = thresh(k, bias)
                    if q < t
                        break
                    o.push(digit_char(t + (q - t) % (P_BASE - t)))
                    q = (q - t) / (P_BASE - t)
                    k += P_BASE
                o.push(digit_char(q))
                bias = adapt(delta, h + 1, h == basic)
                delta = 0
                h += 1
        delta += 1
        n += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

# ---------------- UTS #46 processing ----------------

fn is_xn(l: &[i64]) -> bool = l.len() >= 4 and (l[0] == 120 or l[0] == 88) and (l[1] == 110 or l[1] == 78) and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45

fn all_ascii(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        if c >= 128
            return false
    return true

fn is_rtl_label(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 1 or b == 2 or b == 3
            return true
    return false

# RFC 5893 section 2, rules 1 to 6, for one label of a bidi domain.
pub fn bidi_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    let f = bidi_class(l[0])
    if f != 0 and f != 1 and f != 2
        return false
    var e = l.len()
    while e > 0 and bidi_class(l[e - 1]) == 10 bound 16777216
        e -= 1
    if e == 0
        return false
    let last = bidi_class(l[e - 1])
    if f == 0
        for c in l
            let b = bidi_class(c)
            if b != 0 and b != 4 and b != 5 and b != 6 and b != 7 and b != 8 and b != 9 and b != 10
                return false
        return last == 0 or last == 4
    var en = false
    var an = false
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 0 or b > 10
            return false
        if b == 4
            en = true
        if b == 3
            an = true
    if en and an
        return false
    return last == 1 or last == 2 or last == 4 or last == 3

# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 (ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER) and A.2 (ZERO WIDTH JOINER).
pub fn joiners_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < l.len() bound 16777216
        let c = l[i]
        if c == 8204 or c == 8205
            let virama = i > 0 and ccc(l[i - 1]) == 9
            if not virama
                if c == 8205
                    return false
                var a = i
                var left = false
                while a > 0 bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[a - 1])
                    if t == 5
                        a -= 1
                        continue
                    left = t == 2 or t == 4
                    break
                var z = i + 1
                var right = false
                while z < l.len() bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[z])
                    if t == 5
                        z += 1
                        continue
                    right = t == 2 or t == 3
                    break
                if not (left and right)
                    return false
        i += 1
    return true

# Validity criteria 4.1 except the bidi rules (checked per domain).
fn valid_label(l: &[i64], f: &Flags, transitional: bool, decoded: bool) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    if decoded
        let n = nfc(l)
        if n != copy(l)
            return false
    if f.hyphens
        if l.len() >= 4 and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45
            return false
        if l[0] == 45 or l[l.len() - 1] == 45
            return false
    elif is_xn(l)
        return false
    if is_mark(l[0])
        return false
    for c in l
        if c == 46
            return false
        let s = status(c)
        if not (s == 0 or (s == 2 and not transitional))
            return false
        if f.std3 and c < 128 and not ((c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) or c == 45)
            return false
    if f.joiners and not joiners_ok(l)
        return false
    return true

pub struct Labels
    labels: List[List[i64]]
    err: bool

# Section 4 processing: the converted labels and the error flag.
pub fn process(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Labels
    var m: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        let s = status(c)
        if s == 4
            continue
        if s == 1
            if f.transitional and c == 7838
                m.push(115)
                m.push(115)
            else
                for x in mapping(c)
                    m.push(x)
        elif s == 2 and f.transitional
            for x in mapping(c)
                m.push(x)
        else
            m.push(c)
    let n = nfc(&m)
    var raw: List[List[i64]] = []
    var cur: List[i64] = []
    for c in n
        if c == 46
            raw.push(cur)
            cur = []
        else
            cur.push(c)

module net.idna

# UTS #46 Unicode IDNA Compatibility Processing (revision 33, Unicode
# 16.0.0) and the Punycode codec of RFC 3492, in pure RCE over code
# points (List[i64]). Steps of section 4: map with the IdnaMappingTable,
# normalize to NFC (UAX #15, canonical decomposition, reordering and
# composition, Hangul algorithmic), break at U+002E, convert and validate
# each label (4.1: hyphens, leading mark, status, STD3 ASCII, ContextJ of
# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 and A.2, the six bidi rules of RFC 5893 section
# 2). ToASCII (4.2) adds Punycode with the "xn--" prefix and the DNS
# length checks; ToUnicode (4.3) returns code points, since rce 0.1.3
# cannot build text from arbitrary code points. Every operation returns
# its output together with an error flag, as UTS #46 specifies ("the
# conversion is performed as much as is possible"); the status codes are
# not reproduced (IdnaTestV2.txt requires only the error flag).
# The data section below is generated from the pinned Unicode files
# (vectors/SOURCE.md lists each file with its sha256).

pub struct Flags
    std3: bool
    hyphens: bool
    bidi: bool
    joiners: bool
    transitional: bool
    dns_length: bool
    ignore_bad_punycode: bool

pub struct Cps
    cps: List[i64]
    err: bool

pub struct Ascii
    host: text
    err: bool

# The flags of IdnaTestV2.txt (all checks on) and of the WHATWG URL
# Standard "domain to ASCII" with beStrict false.
pub fn test_flags(transitional: bool) -> Flags = Flags(std3: true, hyphens: true, bidi: true, joiners: true, transitional: transitional, dns_length: true, ignore_bad_punycode: false)
pub fn url_flags() -> Flags = Flags(std3: false, hyphens: false, bidi: true, joiners: true, transitional: false, dns_length: false, ignore_bad_punycode: false)

# ---------------- NFC (UAX #15) ----------------

const S_BASE: i64 = 44032
const L_BASE: i64 = 4352
const V_BASE: i64 = 4449
const T_BASE: i64 = 4519
const S_COUNT: i64 = 11172
const T_COUNT: i64 = 28
const N_COUNT: i64 = 588

fn decompose_into(o: &mut List[i64], c: i64)
    if c >= S_BASE and c < S_BASE + S_COUNT
        let s = c - S_BASE
        o.push(L_BASE + s / N_COUNT)
        o.push(V_BASE + (s % N_COUNT) / T_COUNT)
        if s % T_COUNT != 0
            o.push(T_BASE + s % T_COUNT)
        return
    let d = decomposition(c)
    if d.len() == 0
        o.push(c)
        return
    for x in d
        o.push(x)

# Canonical decomposition followed by the canonical ordering algorithm.
pub fn nfd(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in cps
        decompose_into(&mut o, c)
    var cc: List[i64] = []
    for c in o
        cc.push(ccc(c))
    # stable insertion sort of each run of non-starters by class
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < o.len() bound 16777216
        var j = i
        while j > 0 and cc[j] != 0 and cc[j - 1] > cc[j] bound 16777216
            let t = o[j]
            o[j] = o[j - 1]
            o[j - 1] = t
            let u = cc[j]
            cc[j] = cc[j - 1]
            cc[j - 1] = u
            j -= 1
        i += 1
    return o

fn compose_pair(a: i64, b: i64) -> i64
    if a >= L_BASE and a < L_BASE + 19 and b >= V_BASE and b < V_BASE + 21
        return S_BASE + ((a - L_BASE) * 21 + (b - V_BASE)) * T_COUNT
    if a >= S_BASE and a < S_BASE + S_COUNT and (a - S_BASE) % T_COUNT == 0 and b > T_BASE and b < T_BASE + T_COUNT
        return a + (b - T_BASE)
    return composite(a * 1114112 + b)

pub fn nfc(cps: &[i64]) -> List[i64]
    let d = nfd(cps)
    var o: List[i64] = []
    if d.len() == 0
        return o
    var sp: usize = 0
    var last = ccc(d[0])
    var starter = last == 0
    o.push(d[0])
    var i: usize = 1
    while i < d.len() bound 16777216
        let c = d[i]
        let cl = ccc(c)
        let comp = if starter then compose_pair(o[sp], c) else -1
        if starter and (last < cl or last == 0) and comp >= 0
            o[sp] = comp
            i += 1
            continue
        if cl == 0
            sp = o.len()
            starter = true
        last = cl
        o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# ---------------- Punycode (RFC 3492) ----------------

const P_BASE: i64 = 36
const P_TMIN: i64 = 1
const P_TMAX: i64 = 26
const P_MAX: i64 = 2147483647

fn adapt(delta0: i64, numpoints: i64, first: bool) -> i64
    var delta = if first then delta0 / 700 else delta0 / 2
    delta += delta / numpoints
    var k: i64 = 0
    while delta > ((P_BASE - P_TMIN) * P_TMAX) / 2 bound 64
        delta = delta / (P_BASE - P_TMIN)
        k += P_BASE
    return k + (P_BASE - P_TMIN + 1) * delta / (delta + 38)

fn digit_value(c: i64) -> i64
    if c >= 48 and c <= 57
        return c - 22
    if c >= 65 and c <= 90
        return c - 65
    if c >= 97 and c <= 122
        return c - 97
    return -1

fn digit_char(d: i64) -> i64 = if d < 26 then d + 97 else d + 22

fn thresh(k: i64, bias: i64) -> i64
    if k <= bias
        return P_TMIN
    if k >= bias + P_TMAX
        return P_TMAX
    return k - bias

# Decoding; a failure (bad digit, end inside a number, overflow, a
# result that is not a scalar value) gives err.

pub fn puny_encode(input: &[i64]) -> Cps
    var o: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        if c < 0 or c > 1114111 or (c >= 55296 and c <= 57343)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        if c < 128
            o.push(c)
    let basic = o.len() as i64
    var h = basic
    if basic > 0
        o.push(45)
    var n: i64 = 128
    var delta: i64 = 0
    var bias: i64 = 72
    let total = input.len() as i64
    while h < total bound 16777216
        var m: i64 = P_MAX
        for c in input
            if c >= n and c < m
                m = c
        if m - n > (P_MAX - delta) / (h + 1)
            return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
        delta += (m - n) * (h + 1)
        n = m
        for c in input
            if c < n
                delta += 1
                if delta > P_MAX
                    return Cps(cps: o, err: true)
            if c == n
                var q = delta
                var k: i64 = P_BASE
                loop bound 64
                    let t = thresh(k, bias)
                    if q < t
                        break
                    o.push(digit_char(t + (q - t) % (P_BASE - t)))
                    q = (q - t) / (P_BASE - t)
                    k += P_BASE
                o.push(digit_char(q))
                bias = adapt(delta, h + 1, h == basic)
                delta = 0
                h += 1
        delta += 1
        n += 1
    return Cps(cps: o, err: false)

# ---------------- UTS #46 processing ----------------

fn is_xn(l: &[i64]) -> bool = l.len() >= 4 and (l[0] == 120 or l[0] == 88) and (l[1] == 110 or l[1] == 78) and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45

fn all_ascii(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        if c >= 128
            return false
    return true

fn is_rtl_label(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 1 or b == 2 or b == 3
            return true
    return false

# RFC 5893 section 2, rules 1 to 6, for one label of a bidi domain.
pub fn bidi_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    let f = bidi_class(l[0])
    if f != 0 and f != 1 and f != 2
        return false
    var e = l.len()
    while e > 0 and bidi_class(l[e - 1]) == 10 bound 16777216
        e -= 1
    if e == 0
        return false
    let last = bidi_class(l[e - 1])
    if f == 0
        for c in l
            let b = bidi_class(c)
            if b != 0 and b != 4 and b != 5 and b != 6 and b != 7 and b != 8 and b != 9 and b != 10
                return false
        return last == 0 or last == 4
    var en = false
    var an = false
    for c in l
        let b = bidi_class(c)
        if b == 0 or b > 10
            return false
        if b == 4
            en = true
        if b == 3
            an = true
    if en and an
        return false
    return last == 1 or last == 2 or last == 4 or last == 3

# RFC 5892 appendix A.1 (ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER) and A.2 (ZERO WIDTH JOINER).
pub fn joiners_ok(l: &[i64]) -> bool
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < l.len() bound 16777216
        let c = l[i]
        if c == 8204 or c == 8205
            let virama = i > 0 and ccc(l[i - 1]) == 9
            if not virama
                if c == 8205
                    return false
                var a = i
                var left = false
                while a > 0 bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[a - 1])
                    if t == 5
                        a -= 1
                        continue
                    left = t == 2 or t == 4
                    break
                var z = i + 1
                var right = false
                while z < l.len() bound 16777216
                    let t = joining_type(l[z])
                    if t == 5
                        z += 1
                        continue
                    right = t == 2 or t == 3
                    break
                if not (left and right)
                    return false
        i += 1
    return true

# Validity criteria 4.1 except the bidi rules (checked per domain).
fn valid_label(l: &[i64], f: &Flags, transitional: bool, decoded: bool) -> bool
    if l.len() == 0
        return true
    if decoded
        let n = nfc(l)
        if n != copy(l)
            return false
    if f.hyphens
        if l.len() >= 4 and l[2] == 45 and l[3] == 45
            return false
        if l[0] == 45 or l[l.len() - 1] == 45
            return false
    elif is_xn(l)
        return false
    if is_mark(l[0])
        return false
    for c in l
        if c == 46
            return false
        let s = status(c)
        if not (s == 0 or (s == 2 and not transitional))
            return false
        if f.std3 and c < 128 and not ((c >= 97 and c <= 122) or (c >= 48 and c <= 57) or c == 45)
            return false
    if f.joiners and not joiners_ok(l)
        return false
    return true

pub struct Labels
    labels: List[List[i64]]
    err: bool

# Section 4 processing: the converted labels and the error flag.
pub fn process(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Labels
    var m: List[i64] = []
    for c in input
        let s = status(c)
        if s == 4
            continue
        if s == 1
            if f.transitional and c == 7838
                m.push(115)
                m.push(115)
            else
                for x in mapping(c)
                    m.push(x)
        elif s == 2 and f.transitional
            for x in mapping(c)
                m.push(x)
        else
            m.push(c)
    let n = nfc(&m)
    var raw: List[List[i64]] = []
    var cur: List[i64] = []
    for c in n
        if c == 46
            raw.push(cur)
            cur = []
        else
            cur.push(c)
    raw.push(cur)
    var err = false
    var out: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in raw
        if is_xn(&l)
            if not all_ascii(&l)
                err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var rest: List[i64] = []
            var k: usize = 4
            while k < l.len() bound 16777216
                rest.push(l[k])
                k += 1
            let d = puny_decode(&rest)
            if d.err
                if not f.ignore_bad_punycode
                    err = true
                    out.push(copy(l))
                    continue
                if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                    err = true
                out.push(copy(l))
                continue
            if d.cps.len() == 0 or all_ascii(&d.cps)
                err = true
            if not valid_label(&d.cps, f, false, true)
                err = true
            out.push(d.cps)
        else
            if not valid_label(&l, f, f.transitional, false)
                err = true
            out.push(copy(l))
    if f.bidi
        var rtl = false
        for l in out
            if is_rtl_label(&l)
                rtl = true
        if rtl
            for l in out
                if not bidi_ok(&l)
                    err = true
    return Labels(labels: out, err: err)

fn join_dots(ls: &[List[i64]]) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < ls.len() bound 16777216
        if i > 0
            o.push(46)
        for c in ls[i]
            o.push(c)
        i += 1
    return o

# 4.3 ToUnicode.
pub fn to_unicode(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    return Cps(cps: join_dots(&p.labels), err: p.err)

const ASCII_TAB: text = "\u{0}\u{1}\u{2}\u{3}\u{4}\u{5}\u{6}\u{7}\u{8}\t\n\u{b}\u{c}\r\u{e}\u{f}\u{10}\u{11}\u{12}\u{13}\u{14}\u{15}\u{16}\u{17}\u{18}\u{19}\u{1a}\u{1b}\u{1c}\u{1d}\u{1e}\u{1f} !\"#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;<=>?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\\]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~\u{7f}"

# ASCII code points as text; any other code point is written U+FFFD
# (only reachable in an output that also carries err).
pub fn ascii_text(cps: &[i64]) -> text
    let t = ASCII_TAB.chars()
    var o = ""
    for c in cps
        o = o + (if c >= 0 and c < 128 then copy(t[c as usize]) else "\u{fffd}")
    return o

# 4.2 ToASCII.
pub fn to_ascii_cps(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Cps
    let p = process(input, f)
    var err = p.err
    var ls: List[List[i64]] = []
    for l in p.labels
        if all_ascii(&l)
            ls.push(copy(l))
        else
            let e = puny_encode(&l)
            if e.err
                err = true
                ls.push(copy(l))
                continue
            var x: List[i64] = [120, 110, 45, 45]
            for c in e.cps
                x.push(c)
            ls.push(x)
    let o = join_dots(&ls)
    if f.dns_length
        if o.len() < 1 or o.len() > 253
            err = true
        for l in ls
            if l.len() < 1 or l.len() > 63
                err = true
    return Cps(cps: o, err: err)

pub fn to_ascii(input: &[i64], f: &Flags) -> Ascii
    let r = to_ascii_cps(input, f)
    return Ascii(host: ascii_text(&r.cps), err: r.err)

# Code points of UTF-8 text (text is always well formed).
pub fn text_cps(t: &text) -> List[i64]
    var o: List[i64] = []
    var i: usize = 0
    while i < t.len_bytes() bound 67108864
        let b = t[i] as i64
        if b < 128
            o.push(b)
            i += 1
        elif b < 224
            o.push((b & 31) << 6 | (t[i + 1] as i64 & 63))
            i += 2
        elif b < 240
            o.push((b & 15) << 12 | (t[i + 1] as i64 & 63) << 6 | (t[i + 2] as i64 & 63))
            i += 3
        else
            o.push((b & 7) << 18 | (t[i + 1] as i64 & 63) << 12 | (t[i + 2] as i64 & 63) << 6 | (t[i + 3] as i64 & 63))
            i += 4
    return o
